topic: Silicon Valley Bank collapse and FDIC closure in March 2023

fact_checks.description: SVB's closure is anchored to March 10, 2023
matching_facts: On March 10, 2023, Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) failed after a bank run, marking the third-largest bank failure in United States history and the largest since the 2008 financial crisis.

fact_checks.description: The FDIC is identified as an intervening authority
Depositor withdrawals or a bank run appear in the mechanism
matching_facts: SVB faced a bank run as depositors rushed to withdraw their funds amid rising inflation and deteriorating financial conditions in the tech sector, where many of its clients operated.

SVB had heavily invested deposits into long-term treasury bonds, which lost value as the Federal Reserve raised interest rates. Consequently, the bank was unable to meet withdrawal demands, leading to significant losses when it had to sell these bonds at unfavorable prices.
